name: OCS ports of core samplers
plain: OCS carries its own copies of euler, dpmpp_2m, dpmpp_2m_sde, dpmpp_3m_sde, dpmpp_2s, dpmpp_sde, ipndm, ipndm_v, deis, gradient_estimation, heunpp2, dpm_2 and res_multistep, based on ComfyUI's versions. They exist so the groups and merge strategies above can schedule them; on their own they aim to match core.
math:
Same update rules as the core samplers they port (see each core entry).
The euler port: d = (x − D)/σ; x' = x + d·(σ_down − σ), then ancestral noise of size σ_up.
